findings.text: the done_when asks for the full suite's pass/fail totals and a cause per failing id, but only the ~660-test prefix (15.6% of 4228) is observable because both runs hung at the documented sequential stall (exit 143); the report discloses completed=false and its scope, yet the bottom line (line 83) is easy to over-read as a whole-suite verdict when ~3,500 tests are unobserved and attributed as neither passing nor failing.

the thirteen 'pre-existing (un-isolated)' ids rest on their presence in both trees' conduction-prone big-run prefix; the attempt to reproduce them in isolation (batchB.HEAD.log) timed out at 85% (exit 124) without a summary, so their mechanism is unconfirmed — the claim that none is wave-introduced is logically sound (the base predates the wave's only code change f26287e) but the environment-vs-code split among the thirteen is an open question the report labels honestly.

justifications.durability: nothing in the repository changed so no committed test can guard this one-shot measurement; its reproducibility is carried by preserved artifacts (parse_prefix.py, prefix_flags.json, collect.*.txt) and by the still-green committed gates (tests/test_binding_window_inference.py, the plan byte-identity schema gate) that any wave regression would trip first.
justifications.evidence: the gate is recorded not claimed — both full-suite runs sit on disk with exit 143 at the documented stall (after.1b59345.log) and the isolation rerun reproduces exactly the five environment rows (batchA.HEAD.log: 5 failed/1371 passed/4 skipped in 39.12s), and a fresh run of tests/test_binding_window_inference.py plus tests/test_lane_evidence.py at the merged head passes 9/9.
justifications.fit: the report and its artifacts use descriptive names free of plan/gate/version labels and no changelog prose (parse_prefix.py, prefix_flags.json, collect.head.txt), and the method follows the repository's documented sequential-stall recovery idiom by mapping -q char positions to collect-only nodeids rather than inventing a new harness.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the report attributes all 18 observable failing ids at the merged head with a cause category whose counts sum to 18 (lane-wave-merged-head-attribution.md:54) and marks the full suite not-run (lane-wave-merged-head-attribution.md:19) rather than claiming a completion it did not reach.
justifications.scope_discipline: the reviewed worktree at 1b59345 carries no authored commits (read-only role) and the only written paths are the declared report and the run manifest/logs under the crew reports directory, with collect.head.txt and collect.base.txt at 4230/4225 lines matching the stated 4228/4227 collection counts.
